comment: Shared accept/reject cases for body weight numeric_value (parseWeightAmount). Both Next (src/lib/bodyweightdraft.test.ts) and Go (faas/internal/bodyweightdraft) load this file. Reject errors are byte-identical across backends. Accept returns stored (normalized to exactly 2 fractional digits). Range 1.00–500.00 inclusive, kg.
invalidWeightError: invalid weight: positive decimal string from 1.00 to 500.00 inclusive, at most 2 fractional digits, no spaces; e.g. 75, 75.5, 75.50
numericValueMustBeString: numeric_value must be a decimal string
